aob_lane.identity_rule: a0 arms and every zero-relation a1 arm must reproduce the frozen screen receipt bit-identically; positive-relation a1 arms differ by construction (reordered first sweep) and are compared through the preregistered statistics

eps_reference_rule: aob: min positive frozen-screen final error across the five seeds, divided by 10; generator: min positive U1 seed-117 final error across both hosts, divided by 10; frozen before any S1 arm ran; S2 reuses the frozen S1 table unchanged

gate_rules.anytime_nontax_per_host: a2 vs a1 95% paired bootstrap lower of mean relative anytime diff >= -0.05
gate_rules.coverage_complete: 120 a2 arms (12 aob mapped hosts x 5 seeds + 6 cells x 5 seeds x 2 hosts); paired a1 arms come from the frozen S1 screen
gate_rules.final_nontax_per_host: a2 vs a1 geometric mean ratio <= 1.05 with 95% paired bootstrap upper <= 1.05
gate_rules.ov0_exact_no_tax: zero-relation aob a2 arms reproduce the frozen screen receipts bit-identically
gate_rules.routes_unchanged_all_pairs: a2 route equals its paired a1 route

handoff_semantics: last_improved updates only on a strict-best acceptance during a slot; the next slot prefers a remaining neighbour of the improving scope, otherwise falls back to the static S1/baseline order; no_acceptance_event and host_unreachable are counted separately

slot_granularity.ctp: the polish cover is slot-structured (one full block polish per slot, handoff state from its first slot); the interleaved coverage segment keeps the S1 static order and does not seed the handoff state
slot_granularity.gcb: every cold block visit is a slot; handoff state spans all sweeps; neighbours are checkpoint relation edges
